                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS total_loans
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    loans_with_no_issues AS (
        SELECT 
            district.A2 AS region,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region)

                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END AS loan_size_category,
            COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
        FROM 
            loan
        JOIN 
            account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
        JOIN 
            client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
        JOIN 
            district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
        WHERE 
            loan.amount < 100000
            AND loan.status = 'C'
        GROUP BY 
            district.A2,
            CASE 
                WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                ELSE 'Large'
            END
    ),
    percentage AS (
        SELECT 
            t.region,
            t.loan_size_category,
            (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
        FROM 
            total_loans t
        JOIN 
            loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
    )
    SELECT 
        region,
        loan_size_category,
        percentage,
        (SELECT AVG(percentage) FROM percentage) AS overall_average
    FROM 
        percentage
    ORDER BY 
        region)
ORDER BY 
    region;

            district.A2 AS region,

SELECT

    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

Evidence: biggest monthly consumption = MAX(Consumption)

SELECT 
    region,
    loan_size_category,
    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

Evidence: from 2007 to 2009 refers to year between 2007 and 2009; race completion refers to time is not null; percentage = Divide(COUNT(DriverID where time is not null and year between 2007 and 2009),Count (DriverID where year between 2007 and 2009))*100;

To calculate the race completion percentage of Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009, I will first identify the Japanese drivers and then determine how many of them completed races (i.e., have a non-null time) during that period. 

I will start by finding the total number of Japanese drivers who participated in races between 2007 and 2009. 

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver.driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
FROM drivers AS driver
JOIN races AS race ON driver.driverId = results.driverId
JOIN seasons AS season ON race.year = season.year
WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
```

Error: Binder Error: Referenced table "results" not found!
Candidate tables: "race"

LINE 3: JOIN races AS race ON driver.driverId = results.driverId
                                                ^

You are correct, there was an error in the join condition. I will fix the query by joining the `drivers` table with the `results` table using the `driverId` and then filter for Japanese drivers between 2007 and 2009.

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver.driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
FROM drivers AS driver
JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId
JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
JOIN seasons AS season ON race.year = season.year
WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009;
```

Result (1 rows; showing up to 20):
total_japanese_drivers
4

The query returned 4 Japanese drivers who participated in races between 2007 and 2009. Now, I will calculate the number of these drivers who completed races (i.e., have a non-null time) during the same period.

```sql
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT result.driverId) AS completed_races
FROM results AS result
JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
JOIN drivers AS driver ON result.driverId = driver.driverId
WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
AND result.time IS NOT NULL;
```

Result (1 rows; showing up to 20):
completed_races
3

We have 4 Japanese drivers who participated in races between 2007 and 2009, and 3 of them completed races (time is not null). Now, I will calculate the race completion percentage using these values.

```sql
SELECT 
  (completed_races * 100.0 / total_japanese_drivers) AS completion_percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT result.driverId) AS completed_races
   FROM results AS result
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   JOIN drivers AS driver ON result.driverId = driver.driverId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
   AND result.time IS NOT NULL) AS completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver.driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
   FROM drivers AS driver
   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009) AS total;
```

Result (1 rows; showing up to 20):

75.0

The race completion percentage of Japanese drivers from 2007 to 2009 is 75.0%. 

FINAL ANSWER
```sql
SELECT 
  (completed_races * 100.0 / total_japanese_drivers) AS completion_percentage
FROM 
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT result.driverId) AS completed_races
   FROM results AS result
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   JOIN drivers AS driver ON result.driverId = driver.driverId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009
   AND result.time IS NOT NULL) AS completed,
  (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT driver.driverId) AS total_japanese_drivers
   FROM drivers AS driver
   JOIN results AS result ON driver.driverId = result.driverId
   JOIN races AS race ON result.raceId = race.raceId
   WHERE driver.nationality = 'Japanese'
   AND race.year BETWEEN 2007 AND 2009) AS total;
```

    percentage,
    overall_average_percentage
FROM 
    (
        WITH total_loans AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS total_loans
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        loans_with_no_issues AS (
            SELECT 
                district.A2 AS region,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END AS loan_size_category,
                COUNT(*) AS loans_with_no_issues
            FROM 
                loan
            JOIN 
                account ON loan.account_id = account.account_id
            JOIN 
                client ON account.district_id = client.district_id
            JOIN 
                district ON client.district_id = district.district_id
            WHERE 
                loan.amount < 100000
                AND loan.status = 'C'
            GROUP BY 
                district.A2,
                CASE 
                    WHEN loan.amount < 50000 THEN 'Small'
                    WHEN loan.amount BETWEEN 50000 AND 99999 THEN 'Medium'
                    ELSE 'Large'
                END
        ),
        percentage AS (
            SELECT 
                t.region,
                t.loan_size_category,
                (l.loans_with_no_issues * 100.0 / t.total_loans) AS percentage
            FROM 
                total_loans t
            JOIN 
                loans_with_no_issues l ON t.region = l.region AND t.loan_size_category = l.loan_size_category
        ),
        overall_average AS (
            SELECT 
                AVG(percentage) AS overall_average_percentage
            FROM 
                percentage
        )
        SELECT 
            percentage.region,
            percentage.loan_size_category,
            percentage.percentage,
            (SELECT overall_average_percentage FROM overall_average) AS overall_average_percentage
        FROM 
            percentage
    )
ORDER BY 
    region, loan_size_category;

bond_strength AS (

            WHEN bond.bond_type = '=' THEN 2
            WHEN bond.bond_type = '#' THEN 3
            ELSE 0
        END) AS avg_bond_strength
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'
    GROUP BY molecule.molecule_id
),
avg_bonds AS (

        COUNT(bond.bond_id) AS num_bonds
    FROM molecule
    LEFT JOIN bond ON molecule.molecule_id = bond.molecule_id
    WHERE molecule.label = '+'

)
